changelog: - **The offline screen no longer sends marketing users to the internship site** (#2609). `src/app/offline/page.tsx` hardcoded `https://interncrm.com` as its only link, with `target="_blank"`. That page is precached **per origin**, and since #2492 the marketing host installs as its own PWA (its own name, icons and service worker) — so a SaleVali user who lost connectivity was offered a different product, in a chrome-less window inside the installed app, which is the dead end #2147 closed for images. The link is now relative (`/`), which is by construction the origin the app was installed from, and labelled from the dictionary instead of a domain name. The e2e spec asserts the relative href and that the page carries no absolute link at all, rather than re-pinning it to a hostname. Also documents in `docs/disaster-recovery.md` the three hand-written files a database restore cannot bring back — the two marketing Caddy site files and preview's `MARKETING_HOSTS` — because a rebuilt box would otherwise serve the live marketing domain from preview.
